archetypes.name: emergency-docs
archetypes.rationale: Emergency-mode wording spans README, skills docs, and implement skill prose.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the emergency-mode and run-statistics prose for semantic alignment with the current preflight and OOS filing paths. Check that the docs do not imply clarify-state bypass or Step 8+ sole ownership where the Python path now owns the behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: hook-env-regression
archetypes.rationale: The SessionStart regression depends on child-process environment boundaries.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on the new SessionStart stale-token harness. Verify that it actually exercises an ambient stale token without env -i, reaches the resolver branch through a claude-implement cache dir, and asserts only the child resolver environment rather than parent-shell mutation. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: collector-logging
archetypes.rationale: The design collect-results failure branch writes both logs and execution issue rows.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new collect-results non-zero-RC test for coverage of stdout, stderr, failure-log creation, run-log append arguments, and dirty-tree clean routing. Confirm it does not overlap with the existing launch-failure test or mask failures by using an empty log. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
